answer: Standing is built in terraces, not one leap: an identity holds a deposit at each tier, and a higher one opens only after the lower has aged three epochs. Only the top tier counts for voting and the haven of full rewards, so a farm cannot buy its way straight there; it waits out the same aging schedule, one terrace at a time. Because each tier locks once, k clones multiply the waiting into k schedules and the capital into k tiers. Velvet shortcuts are refused: skipping a tier resets the account to the bottom.
